headline: Uzbekistan Foreign Trade Up 6.3% to $65.4 Billion Over Nine Months
summary: Uzbekistan's foreign trade turnover rose 6.3% year-on-year to $65.4 billion during the first nine months of the year, with China and Russia maintaining the largest trading shares.
why: Uzbekistan is Central Asia's most populous nation and is undergoing state-led economic liberalisation, positioning itself as a central transit hub along regional trade corridors.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: Foreign trade turnover grew 6.3% to $65.4 billion driven by bilateral trade with China and Russia.
